About WorthIt Goods

Honest picks, no hype.

What this site does

WorthIt Goods tracks real retailer prices for software, VPNs, utilities, and everyday gear — then publishes comparisons and deal roundups that cite those live numbers. Every headline price on this site comes from a named retailer listing; nothing is estimated or invented.

Who runs it

WorthIt Goods is an independent, privately operated site run by a small team of developers and data folks. It is not owned by, funded by, or affiliated with any of the products we cover.

How we make money

Some outbound links are affiliate links (Amazon Associates and partner programs run through impact.com). Commissions never determine what we feature or where it ranks — see the affiliate disclosure for the full rules. We never accept payment for placements, and we show the actual lowest tracked price even when it pays us nothing.

Data integrity

  • Prices refresh daily from live retailer listings
  • Amazon prices are never used in price tracking or graphs
  • Corrections are welcome and ship fast: contact us
